examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Right-side large drawer with a trigger and header/body/footer panel regions. `Drawer.Content` renders the overlay and the header gets the close button on its own.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: Small (408px), medium (30% of the screen) and large (40%, the default and the widest) side by side.

examples.name: ScrollContent
examples.summary: Long content in `PanelBody` scrolls inside `ScrollArea`. The header and footer stay in the panel flex layout at the top and bottom; only the body scrolls.
